visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a bright white baseball cap, wearing a black sleeveless halter top, is seated at a wooden table in a dimly lit, high-end restaurant. Directly in front of her is an elaborate two-tiered birthday arrangement; the base is a large platter overflowing with sliced exotic fruits like dragon fruit, kiwi, strawberries, and grapes, while the top tier holds a small cake topped with a passion fruit and two glowing birthday candles. She leans in with a wide-eyed, joyful expression and blows out the candles. (2) After blowing the candles, she leans back with a radiant smile and begins to laugh. She picks up a smaller white rectangular plate containing a chocolate dessert and a small square of cake with its own lit candle. She holds this plate in her left hand while gesturing enthusiastically toward the camera and her surroundings with her right hand. The background reveals a modern bar area with bartenders and other diners moving about, while large glass windows show lush outdoor foliage and ambient city lights. (3) The woman continues to gesture and laugh, looking extremely happy as she celebrates. The camera remains static, capturing her from a medium shot perspective that emphasizes the festive spread on the table. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, dominated by the soft glow of candles on her table and others nearby, creating a cozy and celebratory mood. She looks back at the small cake in her hand, still grinning broadly as the scene concludes.
